sn16.6:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahā kassapo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhi vādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn16.6:1.5: ahaṃ vā kassapa bhikkhū ovadeyyaṃ tvaṃ vā
sn16.6:1.6: ahaṃ vā bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyyaṃ tvaṃ vāti.
sn16.6:2.1: dubbacā kho bhante bhagavā etarahi bhikkhū dovacassa karaṇehi karaṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā akkhamā appadakkhiṇaggāhino anu sāsaniṃ.
sn16.6:2.2: idhāhaṃ bhante addasaṃ bhaṇḍañca nāma bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ ābhijjikañca nāma bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ añña maññaṃ sutena accāvadante
sn16.6:2.3: ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti.
sn16.6:3.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
sn16.6:3.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena bhaṇḍañca bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ ābhijjikañca bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ āmantehi
sn16.6:3.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca
sn16.6:4.1: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paṭissuṇitvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca
sn16.6:4.2: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadatha
sn16.6:4.3: ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti.
sn16.6:4.5: kinnu me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha
sn16.6:4.6: evaṃ tumhe bhikkhave aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadatha
sn16.6:4.7: ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti.
sn16.6:4.9: no ce kira me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānātha atha kiñcarahi tumhe moghapurisā kiṃ jānantā kiṃ passantā evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadatha
sn16.6:4.10: ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti.
sn16.6:5.1: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn16.6:5.2: accayo no bhante accagamā yathābāle yathāmūḷhe yathāakusale ye mayaṃ evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadimhā
sn16.6:5.3: ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti
sn16.6:5.4: tesaṃ no bhante bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
sn16.6:6.1: taggha tumhe bhikkhave accayo accagamā yathābāle yathāmūḷhe yathāakusale ye tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā aññamaññaṃ sutena accāvadittha
sn16.6:6.2: ehi bhikkhu ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatīti
sn16.6:6.3: yato ca kho tumhe bhikkhave accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarotha taṃ vo mayaṃ accayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
sn16.6:6.4: vuḍḍhi hesā bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ ca saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
